title: bn254-pairing-inversion: Pure-Scalar C6-m184_w216-rec STNFS with <2^62 3-Prime NTT, 1.15x-Capped Exact-Per-Depth Band-3 Walk, Fixed Q_shift=60, fp128 MGS, Exact-HNF Nonprimitive Model, & B_max=10 NB(r=1) Metered-DAG Descent: 2^87.467506699

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the self-contained 100% pure-scalar AArch64 algorithm of proof.md (C6-m184_w216-rec reciprocal rank-2 sextic tower, tau=Frob^10, exact sigma(w)==w, 3-class 2-adic yield on 61,051 exact-HNF primitive cells + early primitivity reject inside C_NORMS=30,000 + direct 68-bin exact-HNF nonprim_bins model over 28,100 nonprimitive cells under H1/H2, score-only 3-band g-side sieving at B_f=2^61, B_g=2^60, exc=0.82 with strict <2^64 B per-owner buffered hits C_HIT_LO=13.25/C_HIT_HI=14.5/C_BKT_B3=20.0, Band-3 [2^55,2^59) sigma-folded 12D E* walk with exact-per-depth stack-reloaded <=16-GPR chunk init 104 Ir at k=1 & 40+16k<=216 Ir at k=2..11 scaled by RHO_GS_CAP=1.15x unbalanced-GSO cap (audited on 24 real production p in [2^55,2^59] C6 ideals + 4 live walked orbits) + FIXED Q_shift=60 + per-orbit fp128 MGS u_128=2^-113 & PAD_INT=2^-16 deriving X_max<=4096 & p_num=0 under H1' (max||b_i||<=1, ||E^-1||_F<=4096), closed-form <2^62 3-prime NTT 116*2^55+1/69*2^55+1/57*2^55+1 + Karatsuba >2^55 with zero Montgomery carry overflow & zero H-FFT, full de Bruijn rho_dB, un-discounted 5-SM, 1-owner Z[omega] BW (768,30) W<=161 zero-loss excess trim + reverse backsub under fixed-instance H3, and 62-row LB=59 k=1 DAG + B_max=10 i.i.d. root-only boot retries under H5 i.i.d. prob_b & NB(r=1) with hard meter t=2^112) recovers x with g^x=z and outputs Q=[x]Q0 in G2 (output <= 2^11.761903, verified e(P0,Q)=z) with success >= 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*2^88.825950571 <= 2^87.467506699 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instructions; strictly expected work, not every-run), under declared heuristics H1-H5, H-EA, H-SM, H-R, H-X, H-SEP (proof.md §6, RANK-BRIDGE.md). Run gate opens iff fresh 64-bit u < K=7194280548710566105 (least K with (K/2^64)*0.999993 >= 0.39); closed run costs 1 unit. Opened-run success >= 0.999993 via FIX-U. Prototypes give compatibility evidence (not certification). All costs charged once; nothing amortized.

experiments.purpose: Self-contained pure-stdlib live verification (19/19 checks) of: BN254 + C6-m184_w216-rec algebra, exact sigma(w)==w, 3 <2^62 NTT primes + live uint64 Montgomery zero-carry check, boot identity, mod-r CRT; R^2=50 Voronoi FD (107/107); Band-2 8-lane SWAR sb_u7 (1523/1523), 64-bit a_slot linear index, P_2 +48, 10k SWAR scan+zero, 417-chunk P_14 Stage-B; Band-3 sigma-folded 12D E* walk with exact int128 Q1.60 recurrence + 5-op signed int128*int64 + walked nodes/init vs unbalanced GSO (1.0184, 0.9727 <= 1.15; 408/408, 0 drift, 0 fn) + prod 512-step Cauchy-Schwarz + 24-ideal production p in [2^55,2^59] unbalanced-GSO & H1' audit (2 live-rebuilt fp128 MGS vs Fraction, FIXED Q_shift=60, X_max<=4096, 0 missed branches); 24 special-q + 8 G_T boot 12D lattices; 224-ideal depth-2 usable-relation NB(r=1)&NB(r=2) PGF + H-EA campaign (16 live balls, 4 2-hop chains); exact-HNF 61,051 prim + 28,100 nonprim 68-bin partition + 6 live 12x6 O_h HNF divisibility witnesses; live Z[omega] filtsim U'=2^13,2^14 (0 cols lost) + 5-scale ladder; live unplanted 5-SM F_1187^* BW+DLP+Schur (hx_z6.py); 16-row full de Bruijn ledger (1.15x-capped exact-per-depth Band-3 init), H3 4-cap 1-owner LA, 62-row k=1 B_max=10 NB(r=1) t=2^112 descent, FIX-U, and exact rational gate K.
